Rishi / team — reviewing their asks. High-level legal notes (will attach a short PDF of redlines):

- Auto-renew: We can accept a single annual renewal option but need to change the termination notice window from 30 to 60 days for an 18-month term to protect both parties. Proposed language: "Either party may elect to renew the Agreement for an additional 12-month term upon written notice no later than 60 days prior to the then-current term end date."
- Pricing recalc: suggest a mid-term checkpoint at month 9 to review usage; pricing adjustments limited to the next billing period and capped at +10% unless both parties agree.
- Exhibit C: We'll propose capacity bands and include a clause for temporary burst credits vs permanent uplift to avoid billing disputes during pilot months.

I will attach: MSA_redline_comments_20270614.pdf and a marked Exhibit C spreadsheet. If Solstice procurement accepts the 60-day notice and the 9-month checkpoint, we should be able to deliver countersignature by Friday.

Rishi / Monica — technical ops + pricing notes: we can add the 20% uplift to month 1 effective usage and create Exhibit C bands for the 18-month window. A couple of practical suggestions:

- Add a temporary burst bucket for the first 60 days to cover onboarding spikes; bill at the burst rate and then reconcile to permanent capacity after day 60.
- Add a clause that any mid-term pricing change requires 15 business days advance notice and the next invoice reflects the agreed change. That mirrors our billing cadence and avoids retroactive adjustments.

I'm attaching Exhibit-C-capacity-schedule.xlsx (marked). I'd vote to accept Solstice's 45-day ask only if legal is comfortable; otherwise stick to Monica's 60-day suggested language. If legal signs off today I can prep the final Exhibit and hand to Sales for signature routing.
